Coordinator update 2026-09-26T22:55Z.

1) Root reposync history-cache patch — targeted refutation (Run wf_54499b1e-30a, astra xhigh) found ONE major defect, reproduced 3/3 under -race:
- Location: worktree/history.go:76 (patched).
- Scenario: after a capture, replace trunk with an independent root and make the cached prerequisite's loose object unreadable. `git rev-parse --verify --quiet` prints "Permission denied" on stderr and exits 1. The patch treats that exit as "missing", so Capture silently rebuilds and returns Complete=true instead of surfacing the git error. The pre-patch code propagated it.
- Codex reply file: /Users/yasyf/.cache/codex-ask/runs/codex-run.d35a4181-11b2-4459-a00b-da596d0ad695/refute-history-cache/codex-r-353036574
- Every other variant passed: missing middle bundle, GC'd chain tip still in the ledger, amend/rebase after partial chain loss, sha256, concurrent capture over a shared common dir, source read-only.
- INSTRUCTION FOR THE reposync MERGE STAGE (Run wf_37624322-e25, reposync:merge-fixes): apply reviews/reposync-history-cache.patch, then fix this defect failing-first in worktree/history.go. Treat verify exit 1 as "missing" only when stderr carries no diagnostic; otherwise propagate the git error wrapped with %w. Add the unreadable-prerequisite regression test (chmod 000 on the loose object, restored in t.Cleanup). Keep it to history.go and its tests.

2) New P1 background-fetch policy (reviews/background-fetch-policy.json) → Run wf_3d1be1ea-ac2 on cc-sync/fetch-policy (worktree ~/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/fetch-policy, from phase2c 7e7e7cc).
- Both root repros land as failing-first regressions.
- Fix scope: per-verification FetchAllowed recheck in Consumer.settle; the in-flight verify/git ctx is cancelled on a restricted, unknown, disconnected or manual-metered transition; auto-resume when unrestricted; a policy-cancelled verification stays deferred (never failed or Ready).
- It also audits the pickup origin/LFS fetch path for stale one-time admission.
- Closes with a targeted astra refutation (up to 2 repair rounds).

3) Phase-2c prep complete: cc-sync/phase2c @ 7e7e7cc (pushed).
- Merged: e2e, sparse, tiebreak. Harness Expirer wiring and the omittedBindings fixture were fixed. detail() now dedups to r.Deferred and the goldens were regenerated. Added TestStatusCountsPickupReadyCheckpoints.
- New macOS e2e CI job with git-lfs and GOWORK=off.
- A speculative go.work e2e run passed 19/19 (112.7s).
- The e2e CI job can't compile until the synckit pin carries daemon.Harness. The final re-pin follows the synckit final merge (Run wf_619de18b-756).

4) Realproc author stopped incomplete: cc-sync/realproc @ 51e053e.
- TestRealProcessHost PASS; G1/G2 SKIP.
- The typed "synckitd too old" error was blocked: old and new synckitd share WireBuild, and the unknown-method reply is an untyped string.
- Decision (option a): synckit rpc exports ErrUnknownMethod, decoded only inside the protocol package from its own frozen reply prefix. The delivery client wraps with %w. WireBuild is NOT bumped.
- cc-sync: service.ErrSynckitdTooOld wraps ErrUnavailable. Status now degrades on ErrUnavailable and still reports helper, network and scheduler state instead of failing.
- Run wf_d6d14f31-d4f:
  - synckit cc-sync/rpc-unknown-method from 803da5d;
  - cc-sync/status-degrade from 7e7e7cc;
  - then the too-old mapping + merge of cc-sync/realproc + updated realproc expectations on a go.work, with TestVersionSkewOldSynckitd run against the old 9014672 tree read-only;
  - targeted astra refutation.

5) synckit docs: the codex docs lane stopped cleanly because the v1→v2 delivery migration is lazy (daemon/delivery.go readDeliveryState not-exist path), not "on first start".
- Decision: the docs describe the trigger as implemented; no runtime change.
- Rerun in the same Run wf_d6d14f31-d4f on cc-sync/synckit-docs from 803da5d: astra drafts, astra fact-checks (including the harness API), slop-cop clean, Claude commits only.
